scope: Implementation follow-up to the 44-item production UX review

issues.title: Quiz submission omits the current selection
issues.change: Commit selections immediately; submit one immutable answer snapshot.
issues.verification: New quiz regressions: final selection and delayed sequential submission.

issues.title: Notes can lose the last 1.5 seconds of typing
issues.change: Keep account-scoped note recovery buffers; serialize saves and ignore outgoing-note UI updates.
issues.verification: New note remount recovery regression; existing Notes suite.

issues.title: Publishing one grade destroys other draft feedback
issues.change: Keep only changed grade drafts and update the saved student row without reloading other drafts.
issues.verification: New two-student grade regression.

issues.title: Assignment deadline editing shifts local time
issues.change: Convert UTC deadlines to local input values and label the displayed time zone.
issues.verification: New date round-trip regression.

issues.title: Profile autosave silently drops changes
issues.change: Persist profile recovery drafts, queue the latest pending edit, and expose saving/error/retry state.
issues.verification: New deferred-request profile regression; profile suite and browser.

issues.title: AI replies can appear in the wrong conversation
issues.change: Guard web and native chat responses by conversation version; reset switching state.
issues.verification: Source review, native type check, web build.

issues.title: Canvas work is shared across accounts on the same browser
issues.change: Scope canvases to the account; expose browser-only storage, PNG export and Add to Notes recovery; surface quota failures.
issues.verification: Canvas browser smoke check; account-scoped storage regression. See legacy-data limitation.

issues.title: Expanded mobile sidebar makes content unusable
issues.change: Use a narrow-screen overlay drawer with focus containment, background inert state and Escape dismissal.
issues.verification: 375px Notes: drawer 280px, content 285px, no document overflow, Escape verified.

issues.title: Authentication and Social Hub navigation exclude keyboard users
issues.change: Make auth navigation actual links and social cards keyboard reachable; include password controls in tab order.
issues.verification: Source and web lint/build.

issues.title: Web flashcard review failures look like success or inactivity
issues.change: Advance spaced reviews only after persistence succeeds; disable pending grades and offer queue retry.
issues.verification: Flashcards suite; browser queue load.

issues.title: Mobile review results count grades that never saved
issues.change: Keep native spaced/MCQ review on the current card when persistence fails.
issues.verification: Native type check and source review; device runtime pending.

issues.title: Mobile note Back treats a pending save as successful
issues.change: Return an unsuccessful save result while native note persistence is already pending, preventing premature Back navigation.
issues.verification: Native type check and source review; device runtime pending.

issues.title: Classroom drafts disappear on accidental dismissal
issues.change: Persist assignment, announcement and submission text drafts; prevent dismissal during saves and protect unsaved file attachments.
issues.verification: New assignment remount and stable-focus regression; classroom tests.

issues.title: Challenge countdown includes AI generation time
issues.change: Start challenge countdown only after loading/generation ends; pause it during errors and submission.
issues.verification: Source review and build.

issues.title: Quiz average misrepresents performance
issues.change: Normalize historical quiz scores to percentages before averaging; preserve zero results.
issues.verification: Two backend regressions for mixed quiz lengths, zero and invalid values.

issues.title: Quiz interruption loses answers and hides failed completion
issues.change: Checkpoint quiz answers, position and original start time; retain failed attempts and retry saving.
issues.verification: New remount and failed-save quiz regressions.

issues.title: Dashboard avatar dialog leaves focus behind the modal
issues.change: Add initial focus, Tab containment, Escape and return focus to the dashboard avatar dialog.
issues.verification: Live: close button initially focused, Shift+Tab wraps to Custom, Escape returns to Edit profile picture.

issues.title: Authentication loses the user's intended destination
issues.change: Retain safe internal return paths through authentication; add actionable workspace retry states.
issues.verification: New safe-return-path regression; existing auth/workspace suites.

issues.title: Saved notes revert to 'Unsaved' without a new edit
issues.change: Derive Saved/Unsaved from the current note snapshot against the last confirmed save.
issues.verification: Note recovery test; source review.

issues.title: Collections conflate failed loading with an empty library
issues.change: Separate failed libraries from empty libraries and expose Retry in Notes, maps, slides, media and review queues.
issues.verification: Existing collection suites; browser Notes, slides and maps checks.

issues.title: Challenge HTTP errors can leave permanent loading
issues.change: Handle challenge non-OK load/create/join/progress responses, expose retry, and guard duplicate actions.
issues.verification: Source review and build; live account mutation not exercised.

issues.title: Media regeneration discards the previous result before success
issues.change: Keep generated media notes visible while a replacement is being generated.
issues.verification: Source review and build.

issues.title: Saving existing media notes depends on another AI job
issues.change: Save already generated media notes directly using a deterministic title; guard duplicate saves.
issues.verification: Source review and build.

issues.title: Media progress is a synthetic percentage
issues.change: Replace fabricated generation percentages with honest progress text.
issues.verification: Source review and build.

issues.title: Dashboard duplicates navigation and hides the next study task
issues.change: Show a primary study-library action first on mobile and one static copy of the 12 module destinations.
issues.verification: Live 375px: CTA at y147 below 143px header, height85px; 12 module buttons; no overflow.

issues.title: AI source scope is difficult to predict
issues.change: Clarify curriculum mode, document selection semantics and material references; replace chunk jargon with passages.
issues.verification: Context browser and source review.

issues.title: Course tutor handoff does not carry course scope
issues.change: Carry selected section and published material reference identity into Course Tutor; display and persist scope per chat.
issues.verification: Source review/build. Material bodies are not automatically ingested; see limits.

issues.title: Institutional search promises content but searches tool names
issues.change: Describe institutional search as finding teaching/study tools.
issues.verification: Source review and build.

issues.title: Educator evidence actions do not open the named learner's evidence
issues.change: Open the named learner’s signal, activity and assignment evidence; keep learner identity when opening grade review.
issues.verification: Classroom grade regression; source review. Live institutional account pending.

issues.title: Class switching can show stale conversations under a new class
issues.change: Clear class resources while switching and ignore outdated responses; disable sends until recipient data is ready.
issues.verification: Source review/build. Live institutional account pending.

issues.title: Long note previews become enormous accessible button names
issues.change: Give recent note and media buttons concise Open-title names; shorten previews and remove HTML markup.
issues.verification: Notes browser accessibility snapshot.

issues.title: Small controls and metadata undermine mobile usability
issues.change: Increase classroom form text and operational metadata; expand mobile source/folder hit targets.
issues.verification: 375px source workspace reflow; source review. Native touch/zoom acceptance remains device-dependent.

issues.title: Global loading and some context actions are unnamed
issues.change: Name route loading status and respect reduced-motion preference for the shared loader.
issues.verification: Source review/build.

issues.title: Chat and shared-link failures masquerade as absent content
issues.change: Show history load failures with retry; distinguish missing public links from service outages and correct branding.
issues.verification: New 500-to-404 public recovery regression; live invalid shared link.

issues.title: Analytics can label stale data as the newly selected period
issues.change: Surface analytics failures with retry and stale-data notice; prevent previous-range responses replacing current-range results.
issues.verification: Analytics suite and desktop browser.

issues.title: Mobile optimistic actions fail without rollback
issues.change: Apply native calendar, shared-item and settings state only after server success; show actionable failures.
issues.verification: Native type check/source review; device runtime pending.

issues.title: Billing preview changes the displayed current billing cycle
issues.change: Separate subscription price preview from the persisted billing cycle; require plan selection before updating it.
issues.verification: Profile billing regression and browser profile rendering.

issues.title: Native mobile has no institutional workspace routing
issues.change: Resolve authoritative native account role before onboarding; provide an explicit classroom web handoff for institutional accounts.
issues.verification: Native type check/source review; role/device runtime pending.

issues.title: Mobile help and privacy entries are dead ends
issues.change: Connect native Help and Privacy actions to the actual web destinations and report browser-opening failures.
issues.verification: Native type check and verified matching web route definitions.

issues.title: Rate-limit administration hides request failures
issues.change: Expose failed monitoring requests with a stale-data warning and Refresh recovery.
issues.verification: Source review/build; live admin account not exercised.

issues.title: Playlist open/delete actions can silently do nothing
issues.change: Report playlist delete/view failures while retaining the current collection.
issues.verification: Playlist suite and source review.

issues.title: Friend discovery labels a letter-filtered list as nearby
issues.change: Fetch an unfiltered first page of suggested learners instead of searching for the letter a.
issues.verification: Backend compile, frontend build and source review.

issues.title: Landing page makes visitors discover the product proposition
issues.change: Add a learner-focused proposition and Start learning action to the landing page.
issues.verification: Desktop visual check and 375px reflow with no overflow.

issues.title: Unknown URLs redirect silently to the marketing home
issues.change: Render a real Page not found view with back/workspace recovery for unknown routes.
issues.verification: Live desktop/mobile missing-route check.

automated_checks.backend: 2 quiz normalization tests passed; changed Python modules compile

limitations: Native iOS/Android device or simulator runtime was not exercised.
Institutional and admin browser workflows were not exercised with role-specific accounts. Classroom drafts/grading were tested with mocked API responses.
Course Tutor carries section identity and published material references, not automatic material-body ingestion or a new backend AI-policy enforcement layer.
Unowned legacy cerbyl_canvases data is retained untouched; it is not assigned to a new account automatically. An ownership-aware migration is needed if deployed browsers contain that legacy data.

The static detector is not a clean pass: 749 advisory/design-pattern findings remain, largely incumbent fonts, geometry, sidebars and transitions. It is not an accessibility or production certification.
